---
title: "MURANUCI sequencing depth"
output: html_document
---

# Objective

This document automatically extracts the number of reads obtained per sample,
reads retained after quality control and an estimate of non-host reads from the
MultiQC report. Calculations are expressed in millions of read pairs because
the sequencing data are paired-end.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(rvest)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
# Extract the numeric val attribute from a specified column in each
# General Statistics row. It contains the precise value; the number
# displayed in MultiQC is rounded.
extract_general_stat <- function(rows, css_class) {
  map_dbl(rows, function(row) {
    cell <- html_element(row, paste0("td.", css_class))
    if (inherits(cell, "xml_missing")) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(html_attr(cell, "val"))
  })
}

# Parse the shared sample name, FastQC stage and R1/R2 mate.
parse_fastqc_name <- function(sample_name) {
  tibble(
    multiqc_name = sample_name,
    sample_run = str_remove(sample_name, "_(raw|processed)_[12]$"),
    stage = str_match(sample_name, "_(raw|processed)_[12]$")[, 2],
    mate = as.integer(str_match(sample_name, "_(raw|processed)_([12])$")[, 3])
  )
}
```

# Read MultiQC General Statistics

```{r read-multiqc}

multiqc_html <- read_html("../multiqc_report.html")
general_stats <- html_element(multiqc_html, "#table-general_stats_table")

general_rows <- html_elements(general_stats, "tbody tr")

multiqc_stats <- tibble(
  multiqc_name = html_attr(html_element(general_rows, "th"), "data-original-sn"),
  raw_reads_million = extract_general_stat(
    general_rows,
    "mqc-generalstats-fastqc_falco_pre_trimming-total_sequences"
  ),
  processed_reads_million = extract_general_stat(
    general_rows,
    "mqc-generalstats-fastqc_falco_post_trimming-total_sequences"
  ),
  fastp_reads_after_filtering_million = extract_general_stat(
    general_rows,
    "mqc-generalstats-fastp-filtering_result_passed_filter_reads"
  ),
  fastp_reads_retained_percent = extract_general_stat(
    general_rows,
    "mqc-generalstats-fastp-pct_surviving"
  ),
  host_alignment_percent = extract_general_stat(
    general_rows,
    "mqc-generalstats-bowtie2-overall_alignment_rate"
  )
)
```

# Read-pair counts before and after quality control

FastQC analyses R1 and R2 separately. Read-pair counts are therefore calculated
by checking that both files contain the same number of reads and taking their
mean, rather than adding the counts. Using the mean accommodates small
differences due to processing; a check column retains the difference between
R1 and R2.

```{r process-fastqc}
fastqc_counts <- multiqc_stats %>%
  filter(str_detect(multiqc_name, "_(raw|processed)_[12]$")) %>%
  select(multiqc_name, raw_reads_million, processed_reads_million) %>%
  bind_cols(parse_fastqc_name(.$multiqc_name) %>% select(-multiqc_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    reads_million = if_else(
      stage == "raw",
      raw_reads_million,
      processed_reads_million
    )
  ) %>%
  select(sample_run, stage, mate, reads_million) %>%
  filter(!is.na(reads_million)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(stage, mate),
    values_from = reads_million,
    names_glue = "{stage}_R{mate}_million"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_read_pairs_million = rowMeans(
      cbind(raw_R1_million, raw_R2_million),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    qc_read_pairs_million = rowMeans(
      cbind(processed_R1_million, processed_R2_million),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    raw_R1_R2_difference = abs(raw_R1_million - raw_R2_million),
    qc_R1_R2_difference = abs(processed_R1_million - processed_R2_million)
  )

if (any(fastqc_counts$raw_R1_R2_difference > 0.001, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  warning("Alguna muestra presenta una diferencia entre los recuentos de R1 y R2.")
}
```

# Integrate fastp results and host-read removal

fastp reports the total number of individual reads across both mates. This is
divided by two to express the count as read pairs. MultiQC provides the Bowtie2
alignment percentage against the host genome, which is used to estimate the
non-host read-pair equivalents available for taxonomic profiling.

```{r combine-processing-stages}
processing_counts <- multiqc_stats %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(fastp_reads_after_filtering_million) |
      !is.na(host_alignment_percent)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    sample_run = multiqc_name,
    fastp_reads_after_filtering_million,
    fastp_read_pairs_after_filtering_million =
      fastp_reads_after_filtering_million / 2,
    fastp_reads_retained_percent,
    host_alignment_percent,
    nonhost_percent = 100 - host_alignment_percent,
    estimated_nonhost_read_pairs_million =
      fastp_read_pairs_after_filtering_million * nonhost_percent / 100
  )

sequencing_depth_all <- fastqc_counts %>%
  full_join(processing_counts, by = "sample_run") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_remove(sample_run, "_run[0-9]+$"),
    sample_type = if_else(
      sample_id %in% c(
        "Community-2", "COMUNITY-1", "CONTROL-DNA-2",
        "DNA-CONTROL-1", "Gut-1", "Gut-microbiome-2"
      ),
      "Control",
      "Clinical sample"
    ),
    qc_retained_percent = 100 * qc_read_pairs_million / raw_read_pairs_million
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_type, sample_id)
```

# Map to manuscript sample identifiers

```{r clinical-sample-names}
private_map_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
repeat {
  private_map_file <- file.path(private_map_root, "metadata", "MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv")
  if (file.exists(private_map_file)) break
  parent_dir <- dirname(private_map_root)
  if (identical(parent_dir, private_map_root)) {
    stop("Required private sample mapping not found: metadata/MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv")
  }
  private_map_root <- parent_dir
}

sample_key <- read_csv(private_map_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id = source_sample_id,
    patient_id,
    visit = paste0("W", follow_up_week)
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(sample_key$sample_id),
  !anyDuplicated(sample_key[c("patient_id", "visit")])
)

sequencing_depth_clinical <- sequencing_depth_all %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Clinical sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_key, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("PAC", 1:8)),
    visit = factor(visit, levels = c("W0", "W1", "W2")),
    sample_label = paste(patient_id, visit)
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, visit)

if (any(is.na(sequencing_depth_clinical$patient_id))) {
  warning("Some clinical samples could not be mapped to a PAC/visit identifier.")
}
```

# Output tables

```{r save-tables}
write.csv(sequencing_depth_all, "./PLOTS_TAX_SEQUENCING_DEPTH/sequencing_read_counts_all_samples.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
write.csv(sequencing_depth_clinical, "./PLOTS_TAX_SEQUENCING_DEPTH/sequencing_read_counts_clinical_samples.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")

sequencing_depth_clinical %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    visit,
    sample_id,
    raw_read_pairs_million,
    qc_read_pairs_million,
    host_alignment_percent,
    estimated_nonhost_read_pairs_million
  )
```

# Sequencing-depth plot

```{r sequencing-depth-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=7}
plot_data <- sequencing_depth_clinical %>%
  select(
    sample_label,
    `Raw read pairs` = raw_read_pairs_million,
    `After quality filtering` = qc_read_pairs_million,
    `Estimated non-host read-pair equivalents` =
      estimated_nonhost_read_pairs_million
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample_label,
    names_to = "processing_stage",
    values_to = "read_pairs_million"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sequencing_depth_clinical %>%
      transmute(
        sample_label,
        qc_retained_percent,
        nonhost_percent
      ),
    by = "sample_label"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_label = factor(
      sample_label,
      levels = rev(sequencing_depth_clinical$sample_label)
    ),
    processing_stage = factor(
      processing_stage,
      levels = c(
        "Estimated non-host read-pair equivalents",
        "After quality filtering",
        "Raw read pairs"
      )
    ),
    count_label = sprintf("%.2f M", read_pairs_million),
    percentage_label = case_when(
      processing_stage == "After quality filtering" ~
        sprintf("%.1f%% of raw", qc_retained_percent),
      processing_stage == "Estimated non-host read-pair equivalents" ~
        sprintf("%.2f%% of filtered", nonhost_percent),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    bar_label = if_else(
      percentage_label == "",
      count_label,
      paste0(count_label, " (", percentage_label, ")")
    )
  )

sequencing_depth_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = sample_label, y = read_pairs_million, fill = processing_stage)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = read_pairs_million + 1.2,
      label = bar_label,
      group = processing_stage
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Raw read pairs" = "#0072B2",
      "After quality filtering" = "#E69F00",
      "Estimated non-host read-pair equivalents" = "#009E73"
    )
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sequencing depth by sample",
    x = "Patient and visit",
    y = "Read pairs (millions)",
    fill = "Processing stage"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.42))
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.12, "cm")
  )

sequencing_depth_plot

ggsave(
  "./PLOTS_TAX_SEQUENCING_DEPTH/sequencing_depth_clinical_samples.png",
  sequencing_depth_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Summary statistics for Results

```{r summary-statistics}
sequencing_depth_summary <- sequencing_depth_clinical %>%
  summarise(
    samples = n(),
    median_raw_read_pairs_million = median(raw_read_pairs_million, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_raw_read_pairs_million = min(raw_read_pairs_million, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_raw_read_pairs_million = max(raw_read_pairs_million, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_nonhost_read_pairs_million = median(
      estimated_nonhost_read_pairs_million,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_nonhost_read_pairs_million = min(
      estimated_nonhost_read_pairs_million,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_nonhost_read_pairs_million = max(
      estimated_nonhost_read_pairs_million,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

sequencing_depth_summary
```
